deep.reconstruction:
This is the first page of the bundle, so there is no earlier page to set up the problem. Its purpose has to be inferred from the algebra.

Setting. The quantities are:
- a complex point x+yi;
- a real parameter p;
- a constant r;
- unknown functions z, z_1, which are re-expressed through new functions g, f.

The page is a change of unknowns. Riemann trades (z, z_1) for (g, f), and later for (m, n) = (g−f, g+f). The goal is to rewrite two linear first-order expressions in p in a symmetric form. The next page (f.237v) treats a boundary-value problem on the rectangle |x|<a, |y|<b. It uses kernels cos√(1−λ)x and conditions with factors r±1, which looks like an elastic-plate or elasticity problem. A connection between the two pages is plausible but not certain.

Line 1. The expression
  G := z_p (2yi − p) + 2(2r−1) z − z_1.

Line 2. Riemann writes (z_pp (2yi−p) ± z_p (4r+1) − z_{1,p}) i, apparently the p-derivative of line 1 multiplied by i.
- Direct differentiation of line 1 gives z_pp (2yi−p) + (4r−3) z_p − z_{1,p} (my computation).
- So the coefficient of z_p should be 4r−3, unless the coefficient in line 1 is meant to be 2r+1. The later lines confirm 2r−1.

Line 3 (definition of the new unknowns). (8r−2) z = g − f, hence (8r−2) z_p = g_p − f_p.

Line 4 (second defining relation). (8r−2)(z_p (2x−p) + z_1) = 4r g + (4r−2) f.

Line 5. Substituting line 3 into line 4 gives
  (8r−2) z_1 = 4r g + (4r−2) f + (f_p − g_p)(2x−p).
This is correct.

Line 6. Insert lines 3 and 5 into G. The parts (2yi−p) and (2x−p) combine to 2(x+yi−p). The g and f terms give 2(2r−1)(g−f) − 4r g − (4r−2) f = −2g − 4(2r−1) f. Hence
  (8r−2) G = 2(g_p − f_p)(x+yi−p) − 2g − 4(2r−1) f.
This is verified.

Line 7. Riemann writes
  (8r−2) F = 2(g_p − f_p)(x+yi−p) − 8r g + 2f.
Comparing with line 6 (my computation):
- F = G − (8r−2) z;
- equivalently, F = z_p (2yi−p) − 4r z − z_1.
So F is the companion expression with z-coefficient −4r in place of 2(2r−1).

Lines 8–10 (a substitution).
- He sets F = F' + βi.
- He rewrites F and G in new variables g_1, f_1, p_1, with constants α, β.
- The G-line is reproduced exactly by f = −f_1 + αi, g = g_1, p = p_1 (my check). Under this, g_p − f_p becomes g_{1,p_1} + f_{1,p_1}, and −4(2r−1) f becomes 4(2r−1) f_1 − 4(2r−1) αi.
- The F-line, ∓2(g_1' + f_1')(x+yi−p_1) + 8r g_1 + 2 f_1 − 2αi + βi(8r−2), equals the negative of the same substitution in line 7, plus the βi(8r−2) term from F = F' + βi. Its leading sign is struck through or uncertain.
- So this is presumably a reflection or second branch of the same relations, with an overall sign change. The precise intended meaning cannot be fixed from the page.

Line 11. He introduces m = g − f and n = g + f, and notes the combination −(8r−2)g − (8r−6)f, which comes from adding lines 6 and 7.
- The correct sum is (8r−2)(F+G) = 4(g_p − f_p)(x+yi−p) − (8r+2) g − (8r−6) f (my computation).
- In m, n this is exactly 4 m_p (x+yi−p) − 4m − (8r−2) n.
- This matches the next line, which first had −(8r−2)m (cancelled), then 4m. So the marginal coefficient should read 8r+2, not 8r−2: either a slip or a misreading.

Lines 12–13.
- Line 12: 4 m_p (x+yi−p) − 4m − (8r−2) n = (8r−2) n_1 − (8r−2) αi + βi(...).
- Line 13: the same relation in the subscript-1 variables, 4 m_{1,p_1}(x+yi−p_1) − 4m_1 − (8r−2) m_1 (or n_1), equated to constant terms in α, β and then to (8r−2) m.
- These express the summed relation in the old and new variables and equate them.
- The constant terms are only partly legible, so this end of the computation cannot be reconstructed reliably.
errors: Line 2: the p-derivative of line 1 has z_p-coefficient 4r−3 (that is, 2(2r−1)−1), not 4r+1 as transcribed. This is either a slip or the leftover of an earlier version with 2r+1 in line 1. Lines 3–6 confirm that line 1 has 2r−1.

Line 11: the combination of g and f obtained by adding the F- and G-relations is −(8r+2)g − (8r−6)f, not −(8r−2)g − (8r−6)f. Only the 8r+2 version yields the m,n form −4m − (8r−2)n written in the next line. So this is either a slip or a misreading of '+' as '−'.

Line 9: the leading sign of the F-relation is struck through or uncertain. Its terms are the negative of what the straightforward substitution f = −f_1 + αi gives for line 7 (except the added βi term). So either F there denotes a different (reflected) quantity, or a sign was not yet settled.
Lines 12–13: the right-hand constant terms in α, β are illegible or inconsistent as transcribed and cannot be verified.

results.what: Elimination of z, z_1 in favour of g, f, defined by (8r−2)z = g−f and (8r−2)(z_p(2x−p)+z_1) = 4rg+(4r−2)f. This turns two first-order expressions into the form 2(g_p−f_p)(x+yi−p) + linear terms.
results.modern_name: linear change of dependent variables / diagonalisation of a first-order linear system

results.what: Passage to sum and difference variables m = g−f, n = g+f. The summed relation becomes 4 m_p (x+yi−p) − 4m − (8r−2)n.

deep.surprise_reason: The page is routine scratch algebra: linear substitutions and sum/difference variables for an auxiliary system, probably tied to the elastic boundary-value problem on the next page. It contains no identifiable new result, only the working-out of a substitution with a couple of small slips.

checkable.asserts: Line 5 is consistent with lines 3 and 4 (should be 0).
Line 6: (8r−2)G with G = z_p(2yi−p)+2(2r−1)z−z_1 equals 2(g_p−f_p)(x+yi−p)−2g−4(2r−1)f (should be 0).
Line 7 holds with F = z_p(2yi−p) − 4rz − z_1 = G − (8r−2)z (should be 0).
The sum of the F- and G-relations, with m=g−f and n=g+f, equals 4 m_p (x+yi−p) − 4m − (8r−2)n. This requires the coefficient −(8r+2)g (should be 0).
The G-line in subscript-1 variables follows from f = −f_1 + αi, g = g_1 (should be 0).
The p-derivative of line 1 has z_p-coefficient 4r−3 (should be 0), contradicting the transcribed (4r+1).

transcription_corrections: Line 2: the coefficient read as (4r+1) should mathematically be (4r−3); check the image, as the digit may be misread. The sign before it is struck through or uncertain ('±').
Line 6: 'G(8r−2)' is correct; the transcription's G corresponds to Riemann's script capital.
Line 11: the marginal '−(8r−2)g − (8r−6)f' should probably read '−(8r+2)g − (8r−6)f'. Only that form gives the following m,n line.
Line 12: the struck-out term is '(8r−2)m' (or similar), replaced by '4m'. The right side is 'αi + βi' attached to (8r−2) in the margin, which is only partly legible.
Line 10: '4(2r[-+1-])' is Riemann correcting to 4(2r−1)f_1, and '[-+-]' before 4(2r−1)αi should be '−'.
